caveats_raw10_4.label: n=6 closed-form ownership ambiguity (atlas_n6 vs fusion-arch)
caveats_raw10_4.detail: Same 7 anchors (n, sigma, tau, phi, sopfr, J2, mu) appear in atlas_n6 (canonical lookup) + crystallography_n6 + chip_isa_n6 + chip_rtl_gen + fusion_ledger. Each module re-defines them locally as small int/float constants (no shared lib import). This is intentional decoupling but creates drift risk: if any module updates a primitive value, the others remain stale. Suggested follow-up: n6-architecture/INDEX.json could host a canonical anchor table referenced by all consumers, but this contradicts the 'no shared lib import' raw#15 root-agnostic policy. Trade-off documented; no action needed for this extraction.
